summary.text: Danny Nadeau is a Republican state representative from Minnesota House District 34A who has served since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A construction company owner, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he is focused on fraud prevention, health care access and affordability.

paragraphs.text: Danny Nadeau grew up in Medina, Minnesota, and lives in Rogers.

His career experience includes owning and operating a construction company, working as a general contractor, and working as an assistant to Hennepin County Commissioner Jeff Johnson, a program manager in the energy office at the Minnesota Department of Commerce, a researcher in the Minnesota House, and a township administrator in Hennepin County.
He was appointed to the Hassan Park Board.
Nadeau assumed office on January 3, 2023, succeeding Kristin Robbins.
In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Children and Families Finance and Policy and Health Finance and Policy committees, and he is co-vice chair of the Health Finance and Policy Committee.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said his plan focuses on preventing fraud through stronger oversight, audits and whistleblower protections, and that he wants to address health care affordability and workforce shortages and expand housing and child care options.
